prompt.en: Alberta's vast cattle ranches make Canada one of the world's major producers of what?
prompt.fr: Grâce aux vastes ranchs de bovins de l'Alberta, le Canada est l'un des grands producteurs mondiaux de quel produit?

explanation.en: Alberta is known for farming, above all for its huge cattle ranches. Their beef makes Canada one of the world's major beef producers.
explanation.fr: L'Alberta est connue pour son agriculture, surtout pour ses immenses ranchs de bovins. Leur bœuf fait du Canada l'un des grands producteurs de bœuf du monde.

source.quote: Alberta is also renowned for agriculture, especially for the vast cattle ranches that make Canada one of the world’s major beef producers.

verification.evidence: Alberta is also renowned for agriculture, especially for the vast cattle ranches that make Canada one of the world’s major beef producers.
